tools.name: classify
tools.description: Classify `text` into one (or more, if `allow_multiple=true`) of `categories`. Each category is {name: str, description: str}.

categories.description: list of {name, description} dicts, max 20 categories

tools.name: classify_routing_brief
tools.description: Classify a development task into ODD routing category: read-only, trivial, small, delegated-direct, substantial. Hardcoded categories. Returns {choice, confidence, probabilities}. Backend via env var ROUTING_BACKEND: 'local' (kev-9b) or 'cloud' (Jev API).

text.description: the task description / brief to route

tools.name: classify_sentiment
tools.description: Classify sentiment into: positive, neutral, negative. Hardcoded categories. Returns {choice, confidence, probabilities}. Backend via env var ROUTING_BACKEND: 'local' (kev-9b) or 'cloud' (Jev API).

tools.name: classify_support_ticket
tools.description: Classify a support ticket into one of: billing, technical, urgent. Returns {choice, confidence, probabilities}. Hardcoded categories per cactus blog 'one tool, one record' pattern. Fixes the 121M model's list-arg construction bug — the model only needs to pass the text. Backend via env var ROUTING_BACKEND: 'local' (kev-9b, private) or 'cloud' (Jev API, not private).

text.description: the support ticket / message text to classify

tools.name: classify_user_intent
tools.description: Classify user intent into: informational, operational, action. Hardcoded categories. Returns {choice, confidence, probabilities}. Backend via env var ROUTING_BACKEND: 'local' (kev-9b) or 'cloud' (Jev API).

tools.name: extract_invoice
tools.description: Extract structured invoice data from text: vendor, total, currency, due_date, po_number, invoice_id. Uses cactus-needle's Pydantic-based extraction (per cactus blog §'One tool, one call'). Returns typed fields grounded in the text. If extraction fails, returns the raw model output with an error field.

text.description: raw invoice text to extract fields from, max 5000 chars

tools.name: extract_structured
tools.description: Extract typed fields from unstructured text. `fields` is a list of field names (strings) to look for. Returns dict mapping each field to its extracted value or null. Note: this regex-based extractor is fragile — for production use, prefer per-record tools (see `extract_invoice` below and blog §'One tool, one call').

text.description: raw text to extract fields from, max 5000 chars

fields.description: list of field name strings to extract, max 20 fields

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Return the current UTC date and time as {utc, unix, tz}. Triggers force-call this for matching phrasings (bypasses confidence floor).

tools.name: log_event
tools.description: Append a structured event to the audit log (events.jsonl). Note: this tool is fragile for the 121M model (frequent 'ungrounded' errors). For reliable event logging, use Python imports directly.

tools.name: lookup_entity
tools.description: Look up a known entity by name in the in-memory store. `entity_type` is one of 'person', 'city', 'service'. Use 'service' for servers/tools (omlx, ollama, flux, ltx). Returns the stored record dict, or {error: ...}. Note: cactus blog recommends splitting into 3 separate tools (lookup_person, lookup_city, lookup_service) — we keep one tool for compactness; if accuracy suffers, split.

name.description: entity name to look up, e.g. 'Alice', 'Madrid', 'omlx'

tools.name: route
tools.description: Decide which `route` (from `routes`) `input` should be dispatched to. Each route is {name: str, description: str}. Set `n_consensus` (1-5) for confidence proxy.

routes.description: list of {name, description} route dicts, max 20 routes

tools.name: score
tools.description: Score `item` against each criterion in `criteria` (list of strings). Each criterion gets a score in [`scale_min`, `scale_max`] (defaults 1-5). Set `n_consensus` (1-5) for confidence proxy.

criteria.description: list of criterion name strings, max 10 criteria

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search a small in-memory knowledge base for chunks matching `query`. Returns top 3 [{title, body, score}].

query.description: search query, max 200 chars, lowercase words preferred

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Schedule a one-shot reminder `seconds` from now with optional short `label`. Returns the scheduled fire time as ISO 8601.

tools.name: structured_decision
tools.description: Make a structured decision given a `state` dict and a list of `fields` to fill in. Each field must be one of:

state.description: JSON-serializable dict of program state, max 5000 chars

fields.description: list of {key, type, values/min/max, max_length} field specs, max 10 fields

n_consensus.description: number of consensus runs (1-5), 3 gives confidence proxy

tools.name: validate_output
tools.description: Validate `llm_response` against a schema or rule set. `schema_or_rules` is a dict like:

llm_response.description: LLM response to validate, max 10000 chars

schema_or_rules.description: dict with optional keys: required_fields (list[str]), types (dict[str,str]), rules (list[str])
